description: This file defines the DefaultTimesheetAPI class, which provides API endpoints for retrieving default timesheet data in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for fetching a default timesheet based on optional date and employee number parameters, leveraging various traits and external dependencies to handle business logic and data access.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints to retrieve default timesheet data, utilizing traits for authentication, date handling, and timesheet operations. It handles GET requests to fetch or create timesheet records based on optional date and employee number parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve the default timesheet for a specified date and employee number, creating a new timesheet object if none exists, and returning it formatted as a model.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the 'date' query parameter from the request, returning it as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getEmpNumberParamRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the employee number request parameter, marking it as not required and restricting access to certain employee numbers.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET endpoint, including optional date parameter validation and employee number rules.
